The '''A280''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], and was considered one of the best [[Armor/Legends|armor]]-piercing [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] produced during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Though much heavier than [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-issue [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]] such as the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11]],<ref name="BP" /> the A280 was a sturdy weapon and was reputed to be able to cut a fully armored [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in half at medium range. This weapon, along with its predecessor, the [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A]], were marketed as [[Longblaster/Legends|Longblasters]]. The A280 was different from the DLT-20A in that its [[Galven coil|galven circuits]] were clustered near the focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], giving the weapon a slight bulge at the midsection. This also provided the A280 with more power over a longer range.<ref name="BP" />

It could be equipped with a [[Novaless Soni-Optics/Legends|Novaless Soni-Optics]] [[Target Imager]]<ref name="BP" />

==History==
During the final years of the Republic, the A280 was the standard-issue rifle for the [[Planetary Security Forces]] and for [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]] like its [[Special Tactics trooper|Special Tactics]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the A280 became available for the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].

[[File:A280_blaster_rifle_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|200px|left|An Alliance soldier with an A280]]
Throughout the Galactic Civil War, these rifles were primarily utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Rebel soldiers wielded them during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|3|A280 blaster rifle}}</ref> and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Several of these rifles were stolen by [[Janse]] for the Rebels when he left BlasTech shortly before the latter battle.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=A280 Sharpshooter Rifle}}</ref>

The Empire also fought with A280s occasionally. Two were mounted on a [[blaster rack]] inside the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] [[Death Star command center|command center]] in 4 ABY.<ref name="ROTJ" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:A280_Endor.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The A280 as depicted in [[Endor Limited]]]]
The depiction of the A280 has varied over different sources. The image used in this article is that from ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''. Another version was depicted in the [[Endor Limited]] expansion of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], and yet another in its original appearance in the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''.
